title: Han for Each Yaku
description: Practice answering the han of a riichi mahjong yaku from its name and whether the hand is open. Watch out for yaku whose han changes between closed and open hands (kuisagari), and choose the correct answer from 1 to 6 han or yakuman.

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get questions like this.

no_kuisagari.label: Without kuisagari
no_kuisagari.hint: Regular yaku whose han stays the same when you call (1 to 3 han)

kuisagari.label: With kuisagari
kuisagari.hint: Yaku whose han changes between closed and open hands (sanshoku, ittsu, honitsu and more)
